notes: Kitchen: add-ons/options now show on KDS tickets, and voids/refunds automatically cancel open kitchen tickets (works offline too). Order type is now required — cashier must pick Dine In/Takeout/Delivery before charging; no silent default. Managers/admins can void and refund directly (their login is the approval) while cashiers still need a manager PIN; same rule applied to expense voids. All form modals fixed — typing no longer loses focus and browsers no longer autofill credentials into PIN fields. Reports now work on phones — product sales, P&L, customers and other tables switch to stacked cards on narrow screens. Orders list buttons wrap on small screens. Printing fixes: no crash in Expo Go, and dismissing the print dialog no longer logs errors. Clear Transaction Data now also resets local order and receipt numbering.
